name: Fighting in Aden Gulf
storyline: A different take on the popular title Battle in the Gulf of Aden, this time on the Android platform, depicting the combat of the Iranian Army Navy commandos against pirates in the Gulf of Aden region. In this game, you play as one of the commandos from the Yavar 1 operational team, experiencing this action-packed mission from a new perspective. The game serves as a sequel to the PC game of the same name.
summary:
A different take on the popular title Battle in the Gulf of Aden, this time on the Android platform, depicting the combat of the Iranian Army Navy commandos against pirates in the Gulf of Aden region. In this game, you play as one of the commandos from the Yavar 1 operational team, experiencing this action-packed mission from a new perspective. The game serves as a sequel to the PC game of the same name.

Game features:
Stunning graphics with a compact game size
Two modes: a story mode and an endless competitive mode
Compete online with other players by earning higher scores
Numerous power-up and defensive items to assist you and enhance gameplay

And many more features…
